- General railfan/encyclopedic sources: Classic passenger steam power in the U.S. often includes 4-6-2 (Pacific) locomotives; 4-8-4 (Northern) and 4-6-4 (Hudson) also used by big roads; 2-8-4 (Berkshire) more associated with fast freight and some dual service.

No direct mention of the specific museum tied to the provided spreadsheet.

- 2-8-2: Mikado (freight, later dual)
- 4-6-4: Hudson (high-speed passenger)
- 2-8-4: Berkshire (fast freight/dual service)
